class.name: SpineSliderData
class.brief_description: Stores the setup pose for a Slider.
class.description: Stores the setup pose data for a slider constraint, including the animation it references, whether it's additive, looping settings, and scale/offset values.

method.name: get_animation
method.description: Returns the animation referenced by this slider.

method.name: get_additive
method.description: Returns whether this slider uses additive blending.

method.name: set_additive
method.description: Sets whether this slider uses additive blending.

method.name: get_bone
method.description: Returns the bone data for this slider.

method.name: set_bone
method.description: Sets the bone data for this slider.

method.name: get_scale
method.description: Returns the scale value for this slider.

method.name: set_scale
method.description: Sets the scale value for this slider.

method.name: get_offset
method.description: Returns the offset value for this slider.

method.name: set_offset
method.description: Sets the offset value for this slider.

method.name: get_max
method.description: Returns the maximum value for this slider.

method.name: set_max
method.description: Sets the maximum value for this slider.

method.name: get_local
method.description: Returns whether this slider operates in local space.

method.name: set_local
method.description: Sets whether this slider operates in local space.

method.name: get_setup_pose
method.description: Returns the setup pose for this slider data.

members.member: The animation applied by this slider. A new wrapper may be returned on each access.
Whether the animation is added to the current pose instead of overwriting it.
Whether the animation repeats after its duration; otherwise its last frame is used.

The optional bone whose transform property sets the slider time, or [code]null[/code] when no bone is configured. A new wrapper may be returned on each access. Assigning [code]null[/code] is ignored, so this property cannot clear an existing bone.
When a bone is configured, the scale applied to its transform property value to obtain the slider time.
When a bone is configured, the offset added to its transform property value.
When a bone is configured, the maximum slider time for the bone property range, or 0 if nonessential data was not exported.
Whether the configured bone's local transform property is read instead of its world transform property.
The slider's setup time and mix values. A new wrapper may be returned on each access.
